name: requirements-governor
description: Clarifies high-impact ambiguity and generates source-traceable Markdown technical plans for existing software projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create source-traceable technical plans across software projects.
interface.longDescription: Requirements Governor is an explicit-only technical-plan skill for existing software projects. It discovers the active architecture, explains current behavior, affected modules and data, detailed modification logic, exact code locations, user-visible behavior, compatibility impact, and applicable test design before implementation approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $requirements-tech-plan to analyze this requirement and create a dated technical plan covering current logic, affected data, exact code locations, modification logic, compatibility, and applicable tests.
